titulo: A book with a star inside
caption:
A book with a star inside

A book with a star inside.

A mark in the margin of a borrowed book is called marginalia, and later readers often value it more than the page itself.

For whoever lends a book with a mark on the best page.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice and no text on screen except the last card, with music. A room with a table. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes on the left smiles with a pulse, then leans and a closed book slides across the table to a royal blue figure on the right that was looking down. The blue one looks up with wide eyes, the book opens and a small star appears above it. The blue one's eyes turn happy and it pulses, and the black one smiles too. The last card: Choose friction.
comentario_fijado: A small friction, chosen on purpose.
